statement: After acquiring an accurate-enough thermal predictive representation, temporally persistent exploration supplies missing foraging experiences and enables the same scalar learner to satisfy all needs.
direction: learning-only: exploration conditional on fixed predictive representation
rationale: The predictive feature learner regulates temperature extremely well on3/3 seeds but starves, while the weaker representation foraged. This is consistent with a local-control exploration trap, not proof of one. Isolate primitive-step exploration persistence after an identical2000-step model warmup; model coefficients and all other learning/motivation settings are fixed across treatments. Retesting persistence is justified by this new controlled learner; the earlier DQN failure remains negative evidence for that different configuration.
falsification: Promote only persistent variant passing all six unchanged ecology-v2 criteria on each of3 training seeds at final1M. Reject the balanced-acquisition claim otherwise. Report curves, food events and individual evaluation worlds; do not select seeds/checkpoints. Same warmup must yield identical model coefficients, and duration1 must reproduce previous learned-model action hashes. Actual exploration occupancy and illegal terminations must be disclosed.

sources.title: Temporally-Extended epsilon-Greedy Exploration
sources.sectionsRead: 4-4.2,6 Generality and Limitations, AppendixB.1/B.3, read during earlier pilot
sources.mechanism: Persist with uniformly sampled actions for a sampled duration to reach states outside a local greedy-policy neighborhood.
sources.limitations: Same capped zeta2 duration1..32 and nominal occupancy correction as earlier implementation; early action illegality interrupts. No convergence guarantee follows for history-dependent exploration with this approximate Sarsa critic. Evaluation is primitive greedy inference with no exploratory repeats.

sources.title: Live predictive-features-pilot-01
sources.mechanism: Near-perfect thermal regulation with failed food acquisition motivates a conditional exploration ablation; not a selected successful seed.

protocol.warmup: Exactly the same stepwise policy and sensor targets during first2000 transitions; only after model freezing does persistence start. Both perform998000 TD updates.
protocol.controls: Model-step vs model-persistent; original weighted-homeostasis, fixed normalization, lambda0, alpha.03 gamma.97, same epsilon1->.05/50k. Random/untrained/initial frozen present.
protocol.persistence: Zeta2 capped32; epsilon/(L-epsilon*(L-1)) initiation rate. Cached next action is chosen before TD update and replayed on next Choose; independent frozen inference never consumes it. Last pending next-action choice may add one diagnostic decision beyond executed training actions.
protocol.selection: Final1M only; separate preregistered independent full study required if all3 seeds pass, never pooled with these pilot seeds.
